title: The Missing Alibi
author: Astrid Thornbury
blurb: Ivo Dravenmoor, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
